subject: general
question:
The following pie chart shows the percentage of crime cases reported in a particular year across various states.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4b2fa324c3713f4a93bdc6e8182546151d0cead4da7aa0042d8e3b4002928aa7.png] 

If the crime cases in state A (14% in the pie chart) were 672 in that year, what was the number of cases reported in state C and state F together?
solution:
Calculation:

Cases reported in state C = 12%

Cases reported in state F = 30%

Cases reported in state C and F together = 12 + 30 = 42%

Let the entire pie chart be 100%

The crime cases in state A (14% in the pie chart) were 672 in that year.<
